verification_report.summary: The main rational-coefficient separation argument is coherent and the cited GJR26 and CLD25 results otherwise match their uses. However, the proof contains two unsupported steps, so it is not complete as supplied.

gaps.issue: After first choosing a compact strictly affinoid neighbourhood A, the proof claims that GJR26 Proposition 8.3 and §8.4 yield one smooth tropicalization F defined on all of A and simultaneously tropicalizing the h_i. Those results give this construction only locally around a point (G-locally), not on an arbitrary previously chosen A. The proof must explicitly apply the local result at x and then shrink or rechoose A inside the resulting neighbourhood.

The deduction from semipositivity of h and -h to classical plurisubharmonicity invokes the internal reference \Cref{thm:gr-classical-pl}, but the supplied item has no declared premises or strict ancestors and does not state or prove that theorem. Thus the claimed classical pluriharmonicity is unsupported by the authenticated context.

repair_hints: First apply GJR26 Proposition 8.3/§8.4 simultaneously to the tuple (h_1,...,h_s) near x, then choose a smaller strictly affinoid A on which the resulting F is defined. For the final consequence, add the exact statement of thm:gr-classical-pl as a declared dependency, or directly cite and apply the authoritative theorem that an R-PL function on a good strictly analytic space over a nontrivially valued field is semipositive if and only if it is classically psh, checking its hypotheses for both h and -h.
